sections.sectionText: Jr and Sr Industrial Design students will visit Fortune Brands Innovations in Deerfield, IL and Tricorbraun in Oakbrook Terrace, IL. Departure is planned for 8AM, and estimated return will be 8:30PM. This field trip will include a tour of each company's facility, opportunity to learn about professional contexts, and networking with professionals. Students should contact Joey Hartz jhartz4@illinois.edu with questions. A fee to cover travel costs is included with course enrollment. Meals are provided.

sections.sectionText: This course invites design students to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence, emotion, and storytelling in shaping the next generation of products and services. Students will learn how to design for AI-driven experiences that go beyond technical function, emphasizing emotional resonance and human connection. Through critical engagement with contemporary debates on AI, the course highlights the role of emotional intelligence and narrative in creating empathetic, meaningful, and human-centered AI design solutions. This course is open for enrollment to students from engineering, architecture, and both graduate and undergraduate students at the senior/junior level.
